title: 7 expert persona 文件 + KALLAX 专属字段
acceptance_criteria: 7 个 .md 文件存在于 .kallax/experts/default/, 命名严格小写

每个 frontmatter 含 KALLAX 专属字段: id (kallax.<role>.001) / tier / worktree_role (master|conductor|performer) / review_group (A|B|AB) / phase (1|2|3) / rationalizations_count (>=6) / version (semver) / last_reviewed (YYYY-MM-DD) / tickets_served ([] 初始空)
7 节 full anatomy 全部存在: mantras / personality (MBTI+trait) / background / thinking_framework (4 维) / analysis_focus (5 点) / output_format (YAML 模板, 4 节) / Common Rationalizations (>=6 行)
额外 5 节存在: When to Use / When NOT to Use / Process (5 步) / Red Flags (>=5 条) / Verification (3 checkbox)
security.md 必带 When NOT to Use 含: 合规审计 (SOC2/GDPR) / 法律风险 (许可证/合同) / 业务风控 (信用/欺诈) — 走外部专家
pm.md worktree_role=conductor, phase=3, 任务规划+ensuring 视角
kallax tier 仅用 'default', 不引入 optional/extended (三角角色已分众)
bash scripts/check-skill-anatomy.sh .kallax/experts/default/*.md 跑通 (E ticket 未完成时先有 partial check)
notes: 借 EKET 7 节 anatomy + KALLAX 5 维独有 (worktree_role/review_group/tickets_served/version/last_reviewed). 不要照搬 EKET 7 位 (architect/backend/frontend/ux/product/tester/fullstack), KALLAX 7 位: architect/backend/frontend/ux/product/security/pm. 7 节 full anatomy 模板见 EKET-EXPERT-SYSTEM-DEEP-DIVE-2026-06-07.md §6.
